βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
γλαυκώπιδι: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena, ’gleaming-eyed’ (sense uncertain); fem. dat. sg.
δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’ · also continuing a wish after εἴ πως, with a new subject: ’and might (she) grant’ (δοίη δέ μοι εὖχος Ἀθήνη ’and might Athena grant me glory’) · also in a main-clause wish: ’may (Zeus) give’ (Ζεύς τοι δοίη ’may Zeus give you’) · also opt. in a protasis after εἴ: ’if (someone) should give’ (εἴ τίς τοι … εἵματα δοίη ’if someone were to give you clothing’) · also with κέν, potential opt. in a main clause: ’would give’ (δοίη κέν τις χλαῖναν ’someone would give a cloak’)
δόσκον: δίδωμι — give; iterative impf. 1 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδουν): ’I would give, used to give’
θοῇσι: θοός — swift; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
θυμαρέα: θυμαρής — pleasing to the heart (θυμός with the root of ἀραρίσκω ’fit’); adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic θυμαρῆ)
κάλλιπον: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. 1 sg., with apocope (κάλλιπον = κατέλιπον): ’I left’
μάρνασθαι: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. inf.: ’to fight’
μεμαῶτας: μέμονα (μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic μεμαότας), present sense: ’eager’
μοῦνοι: μόνος (Ionic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. nom. pl.
νωλεμὲς: νωλεμής — unceasing, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly, without a break’
νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάθον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπαθον): ’they suffered’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I suffered’
παρήμενοι: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit by; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
πασέων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl. πασέων, epic (= Attic πασῶν)
ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
πολέμιζον: πολεμίζω — fight, wage war; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζον), + dat.: ’fought against’
πολιόν: πολιός — grey, hoary; masc. acc. sg. (also neut. nom./acc. sg.)
πυθοῖ: Πυθώ — Pytho, the older name of Delphi, seat of Apollo’s oracle; fem. dat. sg. Πυθοῖ
πύλῃσιν: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
φασὶν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable), accented from the enclitic
φιλέει: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖ)
φιλέουσ: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, elided (φιλέουσ’ = φιλέουσι; Attic φιλοῦσι)
χάρις: χάρις — grace, favor, gratitude, thanks; fem. nom. sg.
χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
ψυχὴ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. sg.
ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath, soul; fem. gen. sg. (περὶ ψυχῆς ’for one’s life’)
ἀΰπνους: ἄϋπνος — sleepless; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adjective), with νύκτας: ’sleepless’
ἀμείψεται: ἀμείβω — change, cross, pass over; mid. 3 sg., aor. subj. (short vowel) or fut., after ὅς κε: ’passes’
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀπηλεγέως: ἀπηλεγέως — bluntly, without regard for consequence; adv.
ἀποπλείειν: ἀποπλέω — sail away, sail off; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀποπλεῖν)
ἀριστήων: ἀριστεύς — chief, best man; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
ἀφροδίτῃ: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. dat. sg.
ἄλλην: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. sg.
ἄξομαι: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will lead away, take (for myself)’
ἐκτήσατο: κτάομαι — acquire, get for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’acquired’
ἐρίβωλον: ἐρίβωλος — rich-clodded, rich in soil, fertile; fem. acc. sg. (of Scheria)
ἐρίζοι: ἐρίζω — vie, contend, rival (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’could vie’
ἐρρέτω: ἔρρω — go to one’s ruin, be off, be gone; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go to ruin, be gone’ (a curse)
ἐρυθρὸν: ἐρυθρός — red; masc. acc. sg. (οἶνον ἐρυθρόν ’red wine’)
ἐσθλός: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
ἐφράσσαντο: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, take note of; aor. 3 pl. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἐφράσαντο)
ἐχέφρων: Ἐχέφρων — Echephron, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg. · also the adj. ἐχέφρων — sensible, prudent (ἔχω + φρήν); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἐχθρὸς: ἐχθρός — hateful, hated; masc. nom. sg.
ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person reflexive possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν, agreeing with εὐνήν: ’his own (lair)’ · also agreeing with πατρίδα: ’his own’ (ἑὴν ἐς πατρίδα γαῖαν ’to his own fatherland’)
ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. acc. pl.
ἕκηλος: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλετο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἵλετο): ’took (for himself/herself)’
ἕπηται: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 3 sg.
ἤματί: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἡμέρᾳ)
ἦρι: ἦρι — early, early in the morning; adv., epic (from ἦρ): μάλ’ ἦρι ’very early’
ἱρὰ: ἱερός (shortened ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacrifices’
ἴαυον: ἰαύω — sleep, lie down to sleep; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.)
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀρνύμεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ὀρνύναι)
ὁρμήν: ὁρμή — onset, impulse, start; acc. sg., here ’the start, the setting-out’
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ὅσα φύλλα … γίγνεται ’as many leaves as come’
ὑπερέσχε: ὑπερέχω — hold over, rise above; aor. 3 sg.: ’rose over’
ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
